snippet.title: Dokkalfar: The Ballads of Vivi the Dark Elf OST (Vivi'sTheme)
snippet.description:
Dive into the enchanting world of Dokkalfar with our first track release from the official soundtrack of 'Dokkalfar: The Ballads of Vivi the Dark Elf'! Experience the haunting melodies and vivid soundscapes that bring Vivi's captivating journey to life. Join us as we get a sneak peek into the dark, fantastic realm that awaits players.

Composed and performed by Vilakshan Kandwal ( @VilakshanKandwal )  and Abhinav Prajapati
Illustration by Isabela Zaneti

Dokkalfar is an exciting new action-adventure RPG that revitalizes classic gameplay for today's audience. Journey through enchanting realms and uncover a wealth of lore as you experience the legendary stories of the most formidable Dark Elf warrior of all time!

Our first demo releases August 5th, 2025 on Steam!
Visit our steam page at, https://store.steampowered.com/app/3093910/Dokkalfar_The_Ballads_of_Vivi_the_Dark_Elf/
